Eligibility for the Intro to Programming (ITP) course is more specific. To be eligible for ITP, you must:
- Be over 18 years old,
- Have low income (as defined by household income below 60% of the median in your region, considering household size),
- Be seeking a career in tech,
- Live within 90 minutes by public transport of a CYF region (Sheffield, Glasgow, Manchester, Birmingham, London, or Cape Town).

People whose circumstances are not listed as suitable for ITP are encouraged to apply for Intro to Digital instead. Completing Intro to Digital is different from passing the eligibility check for Intro to Programming.

For more details, see CYF's regions page: https://codeyourfuture.io/regions/
